versions.content: Large Data Path TP TpRxIndication Previous identifiers: SWS_LdCom_00067 When Com_TpRxIndication is invoked for an I-PDU with ComIPduLargeData set to true, AUTOSAR COM module shall use the passed I-PDU ID as ( ComIPduHan- dleId ) to derive the corresponding <ComUser_ComCbkTpRxIndication> user no- tification callback and call it with the according Com user callback handle Id.
